exceptions.justification: One person belongs to many organizations; identity spans tenants.
The organization contains workspaces; it is above the boundary.
Resolves which tenants a subject may reach — consulted before tenant context exists.
Domain ownership is organization-level and consulted at login, pre-tenant.
SSO is resolved from the email domain before any workspace is known.

assertions.name: exception-set-closed
assertions.description: Every table without RLS appears in the manifest.

assertions.name: exception-set-complete
assertions.description: Every manifest table that exists has RLS disabled.

assertions.name: identity-class-exact
assertions.description: The identity class is exactly its five named tables — no additions, no removals.

assertions.name: exception-justified
assertions.description: Every manifest entry carries a written justification.

assertions.name: reference-data-no-tenant-id
assertions.description: No reference-data table has a tenant_id column; one that does should be tenant-scoped instead.

assertions.name: reference-data-readable
assertions.description: contentos_app holds SELECT on every reference-data table.

assertions.name: reference-data-read-only
assertions.description: contentos_app holds no INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE on any reference-data table — isolation by privilege, not by review.

assertions.name: rls-enabled
assertions.description: Every non-exception table has RLS enabled.

assertions.name: rls-forced
assertions.description: Every RLS table is also FORCEd, so the table owner cannot bypass it.

assertions.name: policy-present
assertions.description: Every RLS-enabled table carries at least one policy.

assertions.name: policy-for-all
assertions.description: Every RLS-enabled table carries a FOR ALL policy.

assertions.name: policy-with-check
assertions.description: Every FOR ALL policy carries WITH CHECK — its absence permits a cross-tenant write.

assertions.name: policy-canonical
assertions.description: Every policy keys on current_setting(app.tenant_id), except approved variants.

assertions.name: role-exists
assertions.description: contentos_app exists.

assertions.name: app-no-bypassrls
assertions.description: contentos_app does not hold BYPASSRLS.

assertions.name: app-owns-no-tables
assertions.description: contentos_app owns no table; an owner bypasses RLS unless FORCE is set.

assertions.name: no-context-zero-rows
assertions.description: With no tenant context set, a tenant-scoped read returns zero rows.

assertions.name: cross-tenant-read-blocked
assertions.description: Under tenant B's context, tenant A's rows are invisible.

assertions.name: own-tenant-read-permitted
assertions.description: The positive control — the role CAN read its own tenant, without which the isolation checks prove nothing.

assertions.name: cross-tenant-write-rejected
assertions.description: WITH CHECK rejects a write carrying another tenant id.
